description: The NDDev builder toolkit as a native Cursor plugin, plus configuration. Carries two rules, which is this product's own shape for it: the NDDev floor its six sibling systems all keep in their builder setup, and the authoring policy beside it. Until 2026-08-29 this setup shipped the policy alone, so installing the builder here dropped a floor every other harness kept -- the six carry theirs byte-identical from `baseline` to `nddev-builder`, and only this one replaced it.
